paragraphs.text: A typical smoke alarm is a round plastic case fixed to the ceiling. Inside is a small chamber where smoke is detected, and a battery powers the alarm. To check that it works, press the test button on the front until the alarm sounds.

items.quote: Inside is a small chamber where smoke is detected

explanation.en: “a small chamber where smoke is detected” → chamber. The “battery” is already labelled.
explanation.kk: «a small chamber where smoke is detected» → chamber. «Battery» сызбада жазылған.
explanation.ru: «a small chamber where smoke is detected» → chamber. «Battery» уже подписана на схеме.

items.quote: press the test button on the front until the alarm sounds

explanation.en: “press the test button on the front” → test. “Button” is already on the label.
explanation.kk: «press the test button on the front» → test. «Button» сызбада тұр.
explanation.ru: «press the test button on the front» → test. «Button» уже на схеме.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the text. Label the diagram below. Choose ONE WORD ONLY from the text for each answer.

steps.en: Limit: ONE WORD ONLY. Part 1 is inside the case, above the battery.
steps.kk: Шек — ONE WORD ONLY. 1-бөлік корпус ішінде, батареяның үстінде.
steps.ru: Лимит ONE WORD ONLY. Часть 1 находится внутри корпуса над батарейкой.

steps.en: The text: “Inside is a small chamber where smoke is detected, and a battery powers the alarm”.
steps.kk: Мәтін: «Inside is a small chamber where smoke is detected, and a battery powers the alarm».
steps.ru: Текст: «Inside is a small chamber where smoke is detected, and a battery powers the alarm».

steps.en: The battery is already labelled, so part 1 is the chamber.
steps.ru: Батарейка уже подписана, значит, часть 1 — chamber.

steps.en: The label “2 ____ button on the front” asks what kind of button.
steps.kk: «2 ____ button on the front» жазуы — батырманың түрі керек.
steps.ru: Подпись «2 ____ button on the front» — нужен вид кнопки.

steps.en: The text: “press the test button on the front until the alarm sounds”.
steps.kk: Мәтін: «press the test button on the front until the alarm sounds».
steps.ru: Текст: «press the test button on the front until the alarm sounds».

steps.en: Answer: test. Do not repeat “button” — it is already there.
steps.kk: Жауап: test. «Button» сөзін қайталамаймыз — ол жазуда бар.
steps.ru: Ответ: test. «Button» не повторяем — он уже в подписи.
